title: collaborator.session.terminated payload
description: Payload emitted when a collaborator's session is terminated server-side. Drives RFC 8417 back-channel logout dispatch + downstream reactor invocations (Slack, Google Workspace, GitHub, Grafana, …) so the revocation propagates to every consumer with a live delegated session for the user. §13 INTEGRATION_CONTRACT.

collaborator_id.description: UUID of the collaborator whose session was terminated.

primary_email.description: Primary email address of the collaborator, for provider identity matching.

session_id.description: yggdrasil auth_session.id that was revoked. Omitted when the revocation is global (admin revoke / password rotation / offboarding) and not tied to a single session.

reason.description: Canonical revocation reason. Stable strings — adapters keying off this in reactors must support every value.

revocation_id.description: ID of the session_revocation row that records this event server-side. Useful for correlating audit + back-channel dispatch outcome.

emitted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the event was emitted.
